shared.name: Accordion
shared.doc: Field DS M-Accordion (`@field-ds/components` Accordion/Accordion.tsx): disclosure row that reveals its body on tap. Outer surfacePrimary r12 (clips); header min 44h, padding 12, gap 8, surfaceSecondary, optional 20px `iconLeft` 4 from a B14 SemiBold textPrimary title, 20px chevron-down that turns 180° open; header pressed opacity .85. A 1px surfacePrimary hairline separates the body (surfaceSecondary, padding 12). The body is uncovered, not stretched: height 0 ↔ auto + an opacity ramp, 320ms open / 260ms close on `fieldMotion.ease.standard`; instant with reduced motion. Controlled (`expanded` + `onExpandedChange`) or uncontrolled (`defaultExpanded`). <Accordion title="Specifications" iconLeft="info-circle">Water resistant to 50m.</Accordion>

shared.name: ActionBar
shared.doc: M-ActionBar — port of Field Design System `packages/components/src/ActionBar/ActionBar.tsx` (Figma 698:11068, 1735:119). White `surface/primary`, padding 12. Layouts × tones = 8 variants: single one full-width H52 button (optional `top` slot above, gap 12) stacked primary over secondary, full width, H52, gap 12 split secondary | primary side by side, flex 1 each, H52, gap 12 leadingTrailing `leading` slot (flex 1) + primary (flex 1), H48, gap 8 Tone `action` = Field PrimaryButton + SecondaryButton; `neutral` = NeutralButton + SecondaryNeutralButton. Full-screen use: pass it to `<Screen footer>` (adds the bottom safe area). In a sheet use `<SheetFooter layout>`. <ActionBar layout="split" tone="neutral" secondary={{ label: 'Reset', onPress: reset }} primary={{ label: 'Apply', onPress: apply }} /> <ActionBar layout="leadingTrailing" leading={<Price />} primary={{ label: 'Add to cart', onPress: add }} />

shared.name: Button
shared.doc: Central button. Kit variants are the noon app's filled/outline CTAs; `noon*` variants are 1:1 with bappzaar's NoonButton presets (`variant` primary/secondary × `type` default/ghost/dotted, `isLoading`, `renderBefore/After`, title-casing). Their rules are zero-specificity, so a caller `className` can restyle metrics.

props.name: loading
props.doc: Kit variants: the spinner replaces the label. Noon variants (NoonButton `isLoading`): the label stays in place at opacity 0 and the loader is centred over the button, so the width never jumps. Field variants (useLoadingFade): the label stays in place and cross-fades with the spinner over 160ms.

shared.name: Checkbox
shared.doc: Square (squircle) checkbox glyph — bappzaar `NoonIcons.squareCheckboxSVG(selected)`, 20×20 filled with `color`. Purely visual: wrap it in the pressable row that owns the toggle (e.g. checkout DeliveryInstruction). `variant="field"`: Field DS M-Checkbox (`packages/components/src/Checkbox/Checkbox.tsx`), sizes 16 / 20 / 24 (default 24). Off = squircle outline textTertiary #666D85 (borderMedium disabled); on = filled squircle textPrimary #1D2539 (textMuted disabled) with a 2px white tick. Check-in 220ms / recede 180ms `ease.standard`: outline fades out, fill fades in (no scale), tick draws after 120ms. With `onChange` it is a `role="checkbox"` button (press opacity 0.85, ≈44px touch target); without, a visual span. Reduced motion snaps.

props.doc: glyph colour (default variant only; default `currentColor`)

shared.name: Divider
shared.doc: Solid hairline. `vertical` draws a 1px-wide bar of `length` (PLP nav-pill separator: `<Divider vertical length={24} margin="0 8px" />`). `emphasis` follows Field M-Divider: `'low'` (default, border/subtle #F2F3F7) or `'high'` (border/primary #EAECF0); an explicit `color` wins. Renders `role="separator"` (with `aria-orientation` when vertical).

shared.name: DashedDivider
shared.doc: Dashed separator used in account menus, cart gifting, orders (dash 4/4, #F2F3F7), drawn with a CSS gradient. `gap` sets the space between dashes (default = `dash`; Field M-Divider dashed is `dash={4} gap={3}`). `emphasis` as on `Divider`; an explicit `color` wins. Renders `role="separator"`.

shared.name: DottedDivider
shared.doc: SVG dashed line (react-native-svg `<Line strokeDasharray>`), 1:1 with bappzaar's SVG dividers: - `AddressDottedDivider`: defaults (1px tall, dash "2, 2", round caps) - `NoonAccountDivider`: `height={2} dash="4,4" cap="butt" width="93%" centered` (dash "2,2" + width 100% in notifications)

shared.name: EtaBadge
shared.doc: Estimated-delivery badge — Origin Design System `_ETA` (Figma wFRKiKskxZ4vjIHbDVvngJ · 2673:2414), shown on product cards. `type` is the delivery mode, `size` large (primary cards) or small (compact grids, chips); `label` / `value` are the customisable text ("Get in" + "15 Mins", "Get by" + "11 Sep"). Named use cases and `etaFor(product)` live in `src/data/eta.ts`. Artwork in `src/assets/shared/eta/` is the Figma export, used unedited.

props.name: label
props.doc: lead text, e.g. "Get in" / "Get by" (large only)

props.name: value
props.doc: the time, date or date range, e.g. "15 Mins", "11 Sep", "11-23 Sep" (large only)

shared.name: GlassFade
shared.doc: GlassFade — the layer under floating glass containers (tab bar, PDP sticky card, glass footer): a progressive blur (four masked backdrop blurs, 1 → 8px, stronger towards the bottom) under a transparent → white gradient, so the content scrolling under the glass blends into it. Absolutely positioned at the bottom of its (positioned) parent; size it with `style` (`top` / `height`). Purely visual; taps go through. A screen whose sticky footer brings its own fade (`data-glass-footer`) hides the tab bar's.

shared.doc: 40px circular icon button — back, share, search, more (bappzaar NoonBackButton). `variant="field*"` = Field M-IconButton: circle, `size` 40 (pad 10) or 36 (pad 8), icon 20, pressed + disabled bg surface/secondary #F9F9FB, disabled icon #989FB3; press scale 0.98 (xs in, snappy out) like the Field buttons.

The icon gives a small press-like pop on every change, and the whole button pops in on mount. `aboveTabBar` lifts it over the bottom tab bar.
